why: The first rung under the new game, and a restart of the ladder rather than a step up it. A pick buys a package now -- every spell in it at once, one initiative bonus, two picks at round 1 and every second round after (ADR 0056) -- where every set on the ladder was fitted when a pick bought one spell, twice every round. Two things that the eight weights price changed shape underneath them. `ActionScorer.PurchaseTerms` reads a package as the best of its spells plus `tier.InitiativeBonus`, so the `initiative` weight ADR 0032 measured from 0.5 to 2.1 against a small per-spell bonus is now applied to a lump sum of 1 to 5 paid once; and the number of decisions a match holds fell with the cadence, so what a point of tempo buys fell with it. Neither is a claim that the old sets are bad -- they are unmeasured, which is worse, and the journal's readings for them describe a game that no longer exists. No `initial`, so this starts from the built-in weights: starting from stun-first would assume the old climb transfers, and whether it transfers is the question. The opponent list is greedy, stun-first and random -- the baseline, the old champion and the floor -- and a candidate scores the mean over the three with one that falls below the start against any of them ranking last, so it cannot win by learning one (journal, 2026-09-16). stun-first is in the panel because it is the whole test: if the old champion still holds under packages the ladder transferred, and if a set searched from scratch beats it, it did not. The check opponent is search-4, off that line entirely. What would make this worth a rung: a set that beats stun-first on seeds it never saw. What would make it unreadable, and the tell to look for first: the greedy mirror is now degenerate -- Player 1 takes 400 of 400 benchmark matches, where random against random reads 49.5 % (journal, 2026-09-22) -- so two deterministic agents that pick alike on a symmetric board are decided by the seat and not by skill. Mirrored evaluation cancels that for two *different* agents, which is what every pair here is, but a table of scores sitting at 0.5000 across the board is the seat deciding and this rung has no signal to read.
